en: What? What do you want with Team Aqua? The boss isn't here. He's off to grab something important!
text: Ce? Ce vrei de la Echipa Aqua? Șeful nu e aici. A plecat să pună mâna pe ceva important!

en: Where? Wahaha! As if I'd tell you something like that!
text: Unde? Wahaha! Parcă ți-aș spune eu una ca asta!

en: What? Are you one of Team Magma's? I heard they're trying to wake some mighty Pokémon in their hideout.
text: Ce? Ești de-ai Echipei Magma? Am auzit că încearcă să trezească un Pokémon puternic în ascunzătoarea lor.

en: But where is their hideout, anyway?
text: Dar unde-o fi ascunzătoarea lor, de fapt?

en: What? What do you want with Team Aqua? The boss isn't here. He's on his way to Mt. Pyre, on Route 122!

en: Why? Wahaha! As if I'd tell you something like that!
